---
title: 'About'
---

Simulated Federated Learning flow.
Only a single round is run for tnis demo.

Uses inbuilt iris dataset as data.

Data are sampled at random by three different "organizations".

On the first iteration:

- Global params are set at naive values
- Each org samples half of the dataset (75 rows)

Then following is run for all iterations:

- Each org fits a local model by gradient descent
- Local params are collected, and aggregated
- Aggregated params are used to update the initial global params
